description: Seen from above: at the top is an open green plain with a pale dirt road; at the bottom is a darker forested valley with a few small snow-capped peaks. Repaint the middle so the plain descends gradually into the valley — the open grass giving way to rocky foothills and scattered trees, then the denser forest and low mountains — so elevation and vegetation change like real terrain. Remove the straight horizontal boundary running across; nothing may stop on a flat line. Keep the same green, grey and brown palette and pixel-art style.
